subject: Acme MAP: Growth teams rollout & timeline alignment
messages:
From: Sam Coleman <sam.coleman@acme.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: platform@acme.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — Acme renewal + expansion (initial scope)

Jasmine — thanks for taking this on. We ran the internal review with the growth and Platform teams this morning and want to lock a mutual action plan (MAP) to map timelines for two things: (1) expand usage to three additional product teams (Search, Billing, Onboarding) and (2) add the DDoS protection add-on and 99.95% SLA for mission-critical routes.

Quick context: current contract renews 2026-07-31. We expect to finalize commercials and signatures by mid-July if we keep to a tight cadence. Attached is a very rough spreadsheet with current usage and some forecast numbers (Acme_usage_summary_may2026.csv).

Can you propose a weekly checkpoint cadence and a short list of action owners so we can track dependencies on our side?

Thanks — Sam
Sam Coleman
VP Platform, Acme Corporation

Attachments: Acme_usage_summary_may2026.csv (csv)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Coleman <sam.coleman@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Acme renewal + expansion (initial scope)

Sam — appreciate the context and the usage file. I attached a lightweight MAP template (Acme_MAP_v1_20260601.xlsx) with proposed milestones. Suggested cadence: 30-min weekly checkpoints (Wednesdays 10am PT) from now until signature, with additional ad-hoc points for procurement/security reviews.

High-level proposed milestones (from our side):
- Week 1 (by 2026-06-09): Confirm teams + integration owners; agree on evaluation metrics for each team.
- Week 3 (by 2026-06-23): Performance validation and test traffic for each new team.
- Week 5 (by 2026-07-07): Commercial finalize & SOW for add-on.
- Week 8 (by 2026-07-28): Signatures and cutover plan.

Action owners (initial):
- Jasmine Liu (Redwood): MAP owner & executive escalation
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood): commercial lead (pricing, discounts, SLA language)
- Priya Nair (Acme): integration lead for Search team
- Sam Coleman (Acme): procurement & exec decision owner

If that cadence works for you we'll lock recurring invites. I'll also add a column for acceptance criteria per team in the MAP so we can trigger rollouts.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

Attachment: Acme_MAP_v1_20260601.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Sam Coleman <sam.coleman@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Acme renewal + expansion (pricing & SOW notes)

Adding a few commercial notes so we have them on the record:
- Pricing model: we'll scope incremental usage as committed units on Dedicated throughput (predictable p99s) with a volume discount kicking in at +25% YoY usage.
- Add-on SOW (DDoS + 99.95% SLA): draft SOW shared internally; need legal to accept SLA wording.
- Proposal: hold a pricing approval call 2026-06-10 to confirm discount bands and draft order form.

Immediate action items (Redwood):
1) Rishi: prepare draft order form + discount table (due 2026-06-09)
2) Marissa: prepare a short technical runbook for on-boarding Search & Billing teams (due 2026-06-11)

Sam — can you confirm whether Acme procurement needs a PO in advance of the DocuSign? If yes, we'll include PO acceptance timeline in MAP.

Thanks — Rishi
From: Sam Coleman <sam.coleman@acme.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@acme.com>, platform@acme.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Acme renewal + expansion (updates from Product & Procurement)

Quick updates after internal sync:
- Product: confirmed Search and Billing teams will onboard in parallel; Onboarding team is on the waitlist pending resource allocation (likely +2 weeks).
- Procurement: prefers DocuSign-first flow; PO can be provided but typically post-signature for renewals. We can accept that as long as the order form and SOW are final before signatures (we'll need the SOW to include the SLA appendix).

I've attached the May usage CSV and a short note from our platform lead (Priya). Priya flagged a minor perf regression in one endpoint during a load test — she asked if Redwood can run a quick targeted validation for that route as part of the week-3 validation window.

We want to keep weekly checkpoints. Confirming Wed 10am PT recurring works for us. Also — one ask: can Redwood provide a short summary of expected infra changes for the Search team to share with their engineers (security boundary, key rotation, approximate lead time)?

Best,
Sam

Attachments: Acme_usage_summary_may2026.csv; platform_note_perf.txt
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Coleman <sam.coleman@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Acme renewal & expansion (weekly MAP update & owners)

Team — thanks for the updates and confirming cadence. Attached is MAP_v2 with owners, acceptance criteria, and a condensed timeline (MAP_v2_Acme_20260607.xlsx). Key changes since v1: added acceptance criteria per team, a dedicated validation task for the flagged endpoint (Priya's note), and a draft SOW appendix for the DDoS add-on.

Consolidated action items (owner — due):
- Jasmine Liu — lock weekly recurring invite + MAP doc (done) — due 2026-06-07
- Rishi Malhotra — draft order form + discount bands — due 2026-06-09
- Marissa Cole — onboarding runbook + test plan for Search/Billing — due 2026-06-11
- Priya Nair (Acme) — confirm Onboarding team resource timing (+2 weeks?) — due 2026-06-09
- Redwood Engineering (Marissa): run targeted validation for flagged endpoint and share results — due 2026-06-23
- Sam Coleman (Acme) — confirm procurement flow (DocuSign-first) — due 2026-06-09

Next checkpoint: Wed 2026-06-09 10:00 AM PT (30 min). Agenda: (1) acceptance criteria sign-off per team, (2) pricing/order form status, (3) validation plan for flagged endpoint.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567), DocuSign placeholder (https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ACME-ADDON-2026).

Attachments: MAP_v2_Acme_20260607.xlsx; SOW_addon-ddos-protection.pdf

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
